verdict: All three failing force subcases must be blocked under the current CW-10 supplier semantics.
observations: CW-10 records shell_state exited and exit_confirmed true only after lifetime ended and input/control returned.
Main exit while descendants remain is represented as shell_state running and exit_confirmed false.
owned_target_confirmed currently proves only a boolean claim without an explicit fresh liveness contract.
required_invariant: Force requires shell_state running, exit_confirmed false, lifetime running and descendants_clear false.
Separate exact target identity/ownership from fresh target liveness; require target_alive true for the same exact target in the current observation sequence.
Keep ordinary-stop proof and observation.sequence greater than stop request sequence; cached repackaging is not a fresh observation.
After force, retain the full lifetime/input/control termination barrier before mutation or relaunch.
positive_regression: Main exit status may be present while the managed execution remains running/exit_confirmed false with descendants and exact target alive; this may still authorize force after ordinary stop.
acceptance_impact: C-AC-34 remains open until the invariant and tests are added; C-AC-10 full termination barrier remains unchanged.
